strings.惯性权重：保留多少上一代的速度。越大越爱探索，越小越快收敛: Inertia weight: how much of the previous velocity is kept. Larger explores more, smaller converges faster
strings.个体学习因子：向自己的历史最优靠近的强度: Cognitive factor: how strongly a particle is pulled towards its own best
strings.社会学习因子：向全群最优靠近的强度: Social factor: how strongly a particle is pulled towards the swarm's best
strings.每代对每个粒子做一次 2-opt 的概率（memetic 组件，别设为 0）: Probability of applying 2-opt to each particle per generation (memetic component; do not set to 0)
strings.粒子数（大实例自动降配以保证浏览器流畅）: Number of particles (reduced automatically on large instances to keep the browser responsive)
strings.信息素重要度：越大越依赖历史经验: Pheromone importance: larger relies more on past experience
strings.启发式重要度：越大越贪心地选近的城市（TSP 上通常 alpha < beta）: Heuristic importance: larger picks nearby cities more greedily (on TSP usually alpha < beta)
strings.挥发率：越大遗忘越快，越小越容易早熟: Evaporation rate: larger forgets faster, smaller converges prematurely more easily
strings.候选列表长度：每步只在最近的 k 个邻居里选，性能关键参数: Candidate list length: each step chooses only among the k nearest neighbours; a key performance parameter
strings.每多少代对全局最优做一次 2-opt。设为 0 会明显变差: How many generations between 2-opt passes on the global best. Setting 0 makes results clearly worse
strings.蜜源数（=雇佣蜂=观察蜂数量）: Number of food sources (= number of employed bees = onlooker bees)
strings.放弃上限：蜜源连续多少代无改进就被侦察蜂重置。太小浪费好解，太大跳不出局部最优: Abandonment limit: how many generations without improvement before a scout resets a source. Too small wastes good solutions, too large cannot escape local optima
strings.邻域搜索选片段逆转的概率，否则交换两点: Probability that the neighbourhood move reverses a segment (otherwise two points are swapped)
strings.每多少代对全局最优做一次 2-opt 并回灌: Every this many generations, apply 2-opt to the global best and feed it back
strings.随机种子（影响初始播种与邻域采样）: Random seed (affects initial seeding and neighbourhood sampling)
strings.光吸收系数：大=局部搜索强，小=全局探索强: Light absorption coefficient: large = stronger local search, small = stronger global exploration
strings.每次扰动包含的随机 2-opt 试射次数: Number of random 2-opt trial shots in each perturbation
strings.螺旋常数：越大螺旋越展开: Spiral constant: larger makes the spiral wider
strings.单次移动的最大交换比例（防种群坍塌）: Maximum swap fraction per move (prevents population collapse)
strings.变异概率（TSP 上通常比连续问题设得高一些）: Mutation probability (on TSP usually set higher than for continuous problems)
strings.锦标赛规模：越大选择压力越强: Tournament size: larger gives stronger selection pressure
strings.精英保留个数：保证最优解不会退化: Number of elites kept: guarantees the best solution never degrades
strings.每多少代对全局最优做一次 2-opt 并回灌种群: Every this many generations, apply 2-opt to the global best and feed it back into the population
strings.初始温度。0 表示自动：取初始解平均边长，保证初期接受率在合理量级: Initial temperature. 0 means automatic: the mean edge length of the initial solution, which keeps the early acceptance rate reasonable
strings.降温系数。越接近 1 降温越慢、搜索越充分，但耗时也越长: Cooling factor. The closer to 1, the slower the cooling and the more thorough the search, but the longer it takes
strings.每个温度下的尝试次数，默认等于城市数: Number of attempts at each temperature; defaults to the number of cities
strings.温度档数（不是总尝试次数，总尝试 = max_iter × inner）: Number of temperature levels (not the total number of attempts; total attempts = max_iter × inner)
strings.单代向单头狼靠近的最大比例。超过 0.6 会导致种群坍塌，别乱调: Maximum fraction of approach to a single wolf per generation. Above 0.6 the population collapses — do not change casually
strings.每代有多大比例的狼做一次轻量 2-opt: Fraction of the wolves that perform a light 2-opt each generation
strings.每次局部搜索随机尝试多少个 2-opt 移动: How many random 2-opt moves each local search tries
strings.随机扰动概率，防止种群停滞: Random perturbation probability, to keep the population from stagnating
strings.每多少代对 α 做一次 2-opt 并回灌到最差狼: Every this many generations, apply 2-opt to alpha and feed the result back to the worst wolf
strings.禁忌期：一个移动被执行后被禁多少代。太短原地打转，太长搜索受限: Tabu tenure: how many generations a move stays forbidden after being made. Too short and the search circles, too long and it is over-restricted
strings.缩放因子：差分变异的步长比例: Scaling factor: step-size proportion of the differential mutation
strings.交叉概率。排列域上建议 0.2 左右，太高会假跑: Crossover probability. About 0.2 is recommended in the permutation domain; too high gives fake runs
strings.对每个新解做短 2-opt 打磨的概率: Probability of polishing each new solution with a short 2-opt
strings.弃巢比例：每代被随机发现并重新播种的最差鸟窝比例: Abandonment fraction: the share of the worst nests discovered and re-seeded each generation
strings.莱维飞行的步长基数: Base step length of the Lévy flight
strings.莱维指数：越小步长分布越重尾（偶发大步越频繁）: Lévy exponent: smaller means a heavier-tailed step distribution (occasional big steps are more frequent)
strings.r1 初值：振荡幅度起点，线性衰减到 0: Initial r1: starting oscillation amplitude, decaying linearly to 0
strings.俯冲概率：进攻阶段触发莱维俯冲的可能性: Dive probability: chance of triggering a Lévy dive in the attack phase
strings.接受准则：better=只认改进 / restart=无改进重启: Acceptance criterion: better = accept improvements only / restart = restart after no improvement
strings.restart 模式的容忍代数: Patience (in generations) for the restart mode
strings.邻域层数（越大探索越远）: Number of neighbourhood levels (larger explores farther)
strings.or-opt 摘下重插的连续城市段长上限: Maximum length of the city segment removed and reinserted by or-opt
strings.单次 pass 最多链式执行几次交换（变深度搜索核心参数）: Maximum number of chained exchanges in one pass (the core parameter of variable-depth search)
strings.每步抽样的候选断裂点数（don't-look 思想，越大越精细越慢）: Number of candidate break points sampled per step (don't-look idea; larger is finer but slower)
strings.每 N 代无改进就踢一脚双桥；0=关闭: Kick a double bridge after N generations without improvement; 0 = off
strings.频率区间 = 向最优移动的步幅基数范围: Frequency range = range of the base step size towards the best
strings.初始响度（随机游走强度）: Initial loudness (strength of the random walk)
strings.初始脉冲率（定位性开发概率）: Initial pulse rate (probability of local exploitation)
strings.记忆考虑率：从库里取材的概率: Memory consideration rate: probability of drawing from the memory
strings.音高调整率：抄完微调的概率: Pitch adjustment rate: probability of fine-tuning what was copied
strings.初始引力常数 = 移动步幅基数: Initial gravitational constant = base step size
strings.G(t)=G0·decay^t，越快收敛越早: G(t) = G0·decay^t; faster decay converges earlier
strings.滑翔/打磨概率（对当前位置直接 2-opt 试射）: Gliding / polishing probability (a direct 2-opt trial at the current position)
strings.学习阶段用 OX 交叉 vs 交换序列的比例: Share of OX crossover versus swap sequences in the learner phase
strings.每代最差个体被消散迁移的概率: Probability that the worst individuals are dispersed each generation
strings.螺旋常数：越大绕火焰的弧线越弯（探索越强）: Spiral constant: larger makes the arc around the flame more curved (stronger exploration)
strings.每代火花总数基数: Base total number of sparks per generation
strings.最大爆炸幅度（单火花突变次数上限）: Maximum explosion amplitude (upper limit of mutations per spark)
strings.觅食行为每代尝试次数: Number of foraging attempts per generation
strings.视野：每代随机观察的同伴数: Visual range: number of companions observed at random per generation
strings.追尾移动步幅上限: Maximum step size of the following move
strings.精英比例（前 30% 进入频率统计）: Elite fraction (the top 30% enter the frequency statistics)
strings.随机键初始步长 σ₀（相对键空间）: Initial random-key step size σ₀ (relative to key space)
strings.发现者占比（原文建议 0.2）: Share of discoverers (the original paper suggests 0.2)
strings.安全阈值 ST：警戒值 R2 < ST 视为安全: Safety threshold ST: an alarm value R2 < ST counts as safe
strings.加入者跟随步幅上限: Maximum step size of the joiners following
strings.蚂蚁/蚁狮数（一一配对）: Number of ants / ant lions (paired one to one)
strings.初始游走步数（坑最深处）: Initial number of walk steps (at the deepest point of the pit)
strings.全局搜索切换概率 p（原文建议 0.8）: Global-search switch probability p (the original paper suggests 0.8)
strings.列强数量（会随帝国崩溃减少）: Number of imperialists (decreases as empires collapse)
strings.同化吸引系数 β（原文 β∈(0,2)）: Assimilation attraction coefficient β (β ∈ (0, 2) in the original)
strings.全局/局部授粉切换概率（原文推荐值）: Global/local pollination switch probability (the value recommended in the original)
strings.个体数（算法无其他专属参数）: Number of individuals (the algorithm has no other specific parameters)
strings.察觉概率：被偷者发现偷窃者的概率（越大越难偷）: Awareness probability: chance that the owner notices the thief (larger makes stealing harder)
strings.飞行长度：偷窃时向记忆点移动的比例上限: Flight length: upper bound on the fraction moved towards the memory point when stealing
strings.突变率：每个栖息地每代被随机修改的概率: Mutation rate: probability that each habitat is randomly modified per generation
strings.RCL 宽度：每步从最近 k 个候选随机选: RCL width: each step picks at random among the k nearest candidates
strings.每次落点的 2-opt 下探预算（步数上限）: Budget of 2-opt descent at each landing point (maximum number of steps)
strings.每代注入的随机新抗体个数: Number of random new antibodies injected per generation
strings.传播波随机重建概率（勘探占比）: Probability of random reconstruction by the propagation wave (exploration share)
strings.历史最优单独记录，永不回退。: The best-so-far is recorded separately and never rolls back.
strings.两者是不同实现路径（RNG 消耗点不完全一致），不是同一程序的复制。它们共享同一: They are different implementation paths (the random-number draws do not line up exactly), not copies of the same program. They share the same components and the same acceptance standard: reproducible with the same seed, and the best never gets worse.
strings.效果层面没有区别——都能跑、都能画收敛曲线。区别在产出方式：手写算法是一整个类；: In effect there is no difference — both run and both draw convergence curves. The difference is in how they are produced: a hand-written algorithm is a whole class, while a recipe is only a list of modules for seven slots, interpreted by a general engine.
strings.这不是一个手写的求解器——它是七槽管线组合引擎跑出来的一份「配方」：初始化 →: This is not a hand-written solver — it is a “recipe” run by the seven-slot pipeline composition engine: initialisation → selection → crossover → mutation → replacement → local search → termination, with one component module plugged into each slot. The table below is the full assembly list of this recipe:
strings.引擎用单一随机种子顺序驱动所有组件：同种子同结果，任何配方可复现。: The engine drives all components from a single random seed in sequence: same seed, same result, so any recipe is reproducible.
strings.当前初版提供 3 个示范配方（下拉框「组合配方」分组）。自选槽位的交互式组合器在: The first version offers 3 demonstration recipes (the “Composite recipes” group of the drop-down). An interactive composer where you choose the slots is planned (architecture document S7-C).

strings.所有组件复用站内同一份实现（py/components.py）——组合算法与手写: All components reuse the same implementation on this site (py/components.py) — composed algorithms and hand-written algorithms share the operator code.
strings.装配期校验：槽位引用未知组件在第 0 代前报错；排列 IO 契约（无重复城市）逐: Assembly-time validation: a slot referring to an unknown component fails before generation 0; the permutation I/O contract (no repeated city) is verified every generation.
strings.⚠️ 离散化声明：原文机制作用于连续实数向量——本页全部步骤（交换序列、2-op: ⚠️ Discretisation notice: the mechanism in the original paper acts on continuous real vectors — every step on this page (swap sequences, 2-opt trial shots, double-bridge perturbation and so on) is this site's own permutation-domain counterpart designed for TSP; what stays faithful to the original is the scheduling idea and the phase structure, not the individual formulas. To reproduce the original paper, go back to the continuous domain.
